dedupe_keys.name: software and data products for capacity building enables unique near fault observations of the destructive 2025 mw 7 7 myanmar earthquake

description: GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences publishes processed near-fault waveforms and acceleration response spectra from the 2025 magnitude 7.7 Myanmar earthquake. The repository lists north-south, east-west and vertical components in two-column ASCII text files, each with a header. It also supplies a Jupyter notebook describing raw-data acquisition and processing, an HTML rendering, and a Python routine for double integration from acceleration to displacement while preserving static offset. The record is openly accessible and free under CC-BY-4.0. The published waveforms are filtered products from station GE.NPW; they are not spatially representative ground motions for all affected infrastructure. Sampling intervals and numerical processing settings were not checked inside the files. Structural and lifeline modellers could use the spectra or records to test seismic response and near-fault scenarios, with site and unit checks. The dataset complements regional earthquake catalogues with station-level motion records. The processing code is bundled with the observations and does not constitute a separate infrastructure dynamics model.
